mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ci.item_id, ci.item_category, ci.item_name, ci.image_url, ci.drop_rate, ci.base_character, ci.acc_part, ci.created_at FROM collectible_items ci WHERE ci.item_category = 'CHARACTER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_items ui WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ui.item_id = ci.item_id ) ORDER BY ci.item_id ASC

SELECT ci.item_id, ci.item_name, ci.image_url, ui.created_at AS acquired_at FROM user_items ui INNER JOIN collectible_items ci ON ci.item_id = ui.item_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.item_category = 'CHARACTER' ORDER BY ui.created_at DESC, ui.user_item_id DESC
